title: Electric mop replacement pads
text: Electric mop replacement pads. I purchased this set to have spare heads for my spinning mop.  However, I really want just the mops I will NEVER use the "waxing" heads.  Super annoying to have to buy both at a ridiculously high price.  Eh.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: VMAI Electric Mop Replacement Pads, Waxing Pads and Cleaning Pads for G700 & P700 Cordless Electric Mop
features: Cleaning and Waxing replacement pads for G700 & P700 Cordless Electric Mop.
Please be aware that mop pads bought from stores other than VMAI may not be suitable for the machine.
